pages.text: Walk too far and the link breaks: you wake up in your head. A jar with the $(item)Wheels$() module drives at half walking speed: press $(k:key.headinajar.drive). Without wheels the same key tips the jar on its side so it can roll, very, very slowly.

Stranded anyway? Press $(l)Courier$() in the jar menu. A Noggin & Sons courier delivers your body to your head in 30 seconds, from anywhere, for a fifth of your charge. Then press $(k:key.headinajar.swap).
